headword: お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}

definitions.gloss: trial period; free trial; probationary period
definitions.explanation: A limited time during which a product or service can be used for free or at a reduced cost, or a period during which a new employee is evaluated before permanent hiring.

examples.japanese: お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}は{三十日間|さんじゅうにちかん}です。
examples.english: The trial period is thirty days.

examples.japanese: お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}に{解約|かいやく}すれば{料金|りょうきん}はかかりません。
examples.english: If you cancel during the trial period, there will be no charge.

examples.japanese: このアプリにはお{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}があるので、まず{無料|むりょう}で{使|つか}ってみてから{購入|こうにゅう}を{決|き}められる。
examples.english: This app has a trial period, so you can try it for free first before deciding whether to purchase.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in marketing for subscription services, software, and online platforms. Also used in employment contexts for probationary periods ({試用期間|しようきかん} is the more formal equivalent). The お prefix adds a polite, customer-friendly tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう} (during the trial period)
- お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}{終了|しゅうりょう} (end of the trial period)
- {無料|むりょう}お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん} (free trial period)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {試用期間|しようきかん}: probationary period — more formal, often used for employment
- トライアル: trial — loanword used in similar contexts
